inputs.prompt: One continuous fixed low-angle shot in the same gothic Japanese anime style as the supplied frame. The small blue whale-hood girl stands at screen LEFT blocking the end of the heavy log carried by the black-and-gold robed acolyte at screen RIGHT. The stairs ascend behind them to the same distant cross. The acolyte supports the log securely with one arm, reaches his free hand toward her upper shoulder and gives one short dismissive shove. The girl releases the log, takes one small unsteady backward step toward screen LEFT, bends both knees as her weight drops downward, then catches herself on the stone floor with her palms and one knee. Her fall is low, grounded and believable, never a jump. Her boots stay close to the floor, her hips lower before her palms touch down. Her expression is startled and distressed, not smiling. Her cape follows the downward movement with a small delayed flutter. She stays crouched on the floor and looks up urgently after the log carrier as he turns toward the stairs. Keep exactly the same character design, richly embroidered blue whale hood and cape, fur trim, boots, black and gold robe, log, architecture, blue window light and warm braziers. Camera locked, no cuts, no flying, no high kick, no airborne spin, no elastic body, no sudden pose replacement, no slap, no blood. Clear hand contact at the shoulder causes the loss of balance; the wood never hits her.
